items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: But it was Ethel Waters then, you know. She was the big name.

ctx.x: Oh, I understand that. But you had said before you used to hear it coming out of the loudspeakers at the radio stores.
But it was Ethel Waters then, you know. She was the big name.
But Bessie had had many hits in the 20's, and yet you weren't listening to her.
